title: Learning documents
intro: Organize teaching materials, review extracted content and prepare knowledge sources for your question bank.

workspace.stepUploadHint: Assign a PDF or PowerPoint to its topic and chapter.
workspace.stepReviewHint: Inspect each version and the text extracted from its source.
workspace.stepUseHint: Build an index, retrieve context or open the AI workspace.
workspace.uploadHint: Start with teaching materials you have permission to use.
workspace.fileHint: PDF or PPTX · Up to 20 MB
workspace.versionTarget: The new version will belong to: {title}
workspace.documentCount: {count, plural, one {# document in your library} other {# documents in your library}}
workspace.historyHint: Select a document to view its versions, content and processing status.
workspace.emptyHint: Add your first lecture using the upload form. Your materials will appear here, ready to find and reuse.
workspace.previewTitle: Every document, a source of knowledge
workspace.previewHint: Select a library document to review extracted content, manage versions and retrieve context for question creation.
workspace.indexHint: Extracted text must be indexed before it is available for context retrieval.
workspace.queryHint: Search this version once its index is ready. This action does not generate questions.
workspace.queryPlaceholder: Describe the knowledge to look up…
workspace.noResults: No context found. Try describing the knowledge differently.
workspace.revokeHint: Revoking stops processing and blocks access. It does not physically delete the stored file.

rag.title: Index and context retrieval
rag.disclosure: Indexing sends consented content to Google for embedding and may incur charges. Search queries are also sent to Google.
rag.index: Build or check the current index
rag.unassessed: These are retrieved source candidates. Relevance, coverage and factual correctness have not been assessed; no questions have been generated.

consent: I have permission to use this material and consent to processing and storage for AI features. This consent will also cover sending content to an external AI provider.
newVersion: Upload a new version of the open document
noPreview: Content is not available yet. Keep this page open or reload to check its status.
ocr: This document requires OCR. The extracted text below may be incomplete and is not ready for RAG.
extracted: Text has been extracted. Search availability depends on the index status below.
emptyUnit: No text was extracted from this page/slide.
revokeConfirm: Revoke access and stop document processing? Files remain subject to retention policy; this does not physically delete them.
uploadExpired: Upload expired. Upload a new version.
invalid: Check title, topic/chapter, PDF/PPTX file up to 20 MB, and consent.
failed: The operation did not finish. Reload history before creating another document. A finished upload can be confirmed again.

manage.title: Manage document
manage.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete the stored files of this document? Indexes are revoked and this cannot be undone.
manage.purgeHint: Permanent deletion is only available for archived documents with no running plans or batches.
manage.archiveHint: Archiving hides the document from the default list and blocks new plans and batches. You can restore it any time.
manage.conflict: Action rejected: the document is in use or its state does not allow it.
manage.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
manage.quotaExceeded: Library quota exceeded. Archive and delete unused documents first.
manage.archivedNotice: This document is archived. Restore it to generate questions.
manage.duplicateTitle: This file is already in your library
manage.duplicateHint: Reuse an existing document to skip re-uploading, re-extracting and re-indexing. You can still upload it again if you need a separate copy.
manage.reusedExtraction: Same content found in your library: extraction was reused, no new parsing needed.
